message.reasoning:
The user wants to arrange a flight on booking ID 1234, check different options, compute flight cost from first airport in available list to last airport in same list on last day of October 2024 (i.e., 2024-10-31) in business class. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get list of all airports, then get flight cost between first and last airport on that date. Then we need to compute total payable amount. But what is the total payable amount? It might be the flight cost plus maybe insurance? The user didn't mention insurance. They just want estimated total payable amount. Probably just flight cost. But maybe they want to include booking cost? The booking ID 1234 presumably already exists. They want to arrange a flight on that booking ID. So maybe they want to book a flight for that booking ID. But they also want to compute flight cost. So we need to get flight cost, then maybe book flight. But the user didn't ask to book, just to arrange. They want to check different options. So we can compute flight cost and provide that as estimated total payable amount.

We need to call get_all_airports to get list. Then get_flight_cost with travel_from=first airport code, travel_to=last airport code, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. Then we need to compute total payable amount. That is the flight cost. But maybe we need to add insurance? Not specified. So just flight cost.

We need to call get_flight_cost. But we need to get the airports first. So call get_all_airports. Then parse the list. Then call get_flight_cost. Then provide the cost.

We also might need to authenticate? The get_flight_cost doesn't require access token. So no authentication needed.

Thus we need to call get_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then respond.

Let's do that.
